_doc: Canonical, client-neutral server list. `generate.mjs` substitutes {{PLACEHOLDERS}}, renders secrets per client, and emits each client's native config. Custom Python servers under servers/*/server.py are AUTO-DISCOVERED (not listed here). Secret values use '@secret:ENV_NAME'.

_placeholders.{{PROJECT_DIR}}: dir the agent works in (MCP_PROJECT_DIR or HOME)

filesystem.note: Sandboxed file ops, scoped to PROJECT_DIR.

github.note: Local stdio github-mcp-server binary (free on every client; download into <root>/bin).

fetch.note: URL -> markdown. Dropped from Claude Code (native WebFetch).

duckduckgo.note: Web search, no key. Dropped from Claude Code (native WebSearch).

google_workspace.note: Calendar + Drive + Docs (your own Google OAuth).

applescript.note: Universal Mac app + System Events control (keystone). Needs Automation permission.

macos-use.note: UI automation via accessibility tree. Needs Accessibility permission + Xcode CLT.

messages.note: Read/search/send iMessage. Needs Full Disk Access.

apple-events.note: Reminders + Calendar via EventKit. Needs Calendar/Reminders permission + Xcode CLT.

apple-notes.note: Apple Notes (modular griches set; mail/contacts available similarly).

screenshot.note: Screenshot + OCR. Needs Screen Recording permission.
